name: Tesofensine
subtitle: Triple monoamine reuptake inhibitor
summary: Non-peptide appetite drug with real phase-2 weight-loss data — and a stimulant side-effect profile to match.
caveat: A stimulant-class drug: raised heart rate and blood pressure, insomnia and mood effects came with the weight loss.

dosing.source: Astrup A et al. — Effect of tesofensine on bodyweight loss in obese patients: a phase 2 trial · Lancet, 2008
